propositions: Expected best-effort push failures due to contention races and transient transport faults surface at WARNING/INFO to agent sessions, priming false outage investigation and token waste.

Mid-retry transient transport notices and lost-contention terminal outcomes (non-fast-forward rejection, merge success with no growth) are auto-handled and self-healing, but raw git stderr and bare ..HEAD references make them appear as corruption to LLM pattern matching.

The unpushed_summary suffix and backlog counts escalate across concurrent writers without stating the self-healing contract, creating ambiguity between ordinary contention load and persistent operator-actionable outage signals.
Policy declines, strict-mode failures, and proven-growing backlog (prior marker vs current count) must remain loud at WARNING; ordinary contention losses and static backlog must emit DEBUG or below.
All backlog messages must name the tickets branch explicitly (no bare ..HEAD) and state the self-healing contract (committed locally, publish on next successful push) to disambiguate from corruption.
